entities.name: UE-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to initiate NAS transport, handling various abnormal cases like access barring, timer conditions, and transmission failures.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message sent by UE, subject to various conditions and restrictions in abnormal cases.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload container, with values like 'N1 SM information'.

entities.name: Request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of request, with values like 'initial request', 'MA PDU request', 'initial emergency request', etc.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer that restricts sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message unless specific conditions are met.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that restricts sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message unless specific conditions are met.

entities.name: Access attempt barred
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate access attempt is barred, preventing UE from starting NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session exists
entities.description: Condition where an emergency PDU session exists, affecting UL NAS TRANSPORT message transmission.

entities.name: Current TAI not in TAI list
entities.description: Condition where current TAI is not in TAI list, causing NAS transport procedure abortion and registration procedure initiation.

entities.name: RRC connection suspended
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate RRC connection has been suspended, causing NAS transport procedure abortion.

entities.name: NAS MAC calculation indication
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate to calculate NAS MAC, requiring UE to calculate and provide NAS MAC to lower layers.

entities.name: UE configured for high priority access
entities.description: Property indicating UE is configured for high priority access in selected PLMN, allowing UL NAS TRANSPORT message transmission even when timers are running.

relations.description: Access barring condition prevents starting UE-initiated NAS transport procedure.
Emergency PDU session existence condition restricts UL NAS TRANSPORT message transmission.
TAI not in list condition causes NAS transport procedure abortion and registration procedure initiation.
Timer T3447 running restricts UL NAS TRANSPORT message transmission unless specific conditions are met.
Timer T3346 running restricts UL NAS TRANSPORT message transmission unless specific conditions are met.
RRC connection suspended condition causes NAS transport procedure abortion.
NAS MAC calculation indication requires UE to calculate NAS MAC before sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message.
UE high priority access property allows UL NAS TRANSPORT message transmission even when timers T3447 or T3346 are running.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container type IE.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Request type IE.
